question.tr: Satıcı açıklaması modele eklenince OOF doğruluğu ne kadar değişir?
question.en: How much does the out-of-fold accuracy change when the seller's description is added to the model?

data_slice: load_clean(): the 29,988 unique TR-plated listings the model is trained on (latest snapshot per ad_id).
split: kfold_oof: the model's own 5 folds (analysis/lib/cv.make_folds, KFold shuffle, seed 42).
target: log1p(price). Base arm = this run's model OOF (cv.load_oof, the §7 LightGBM with the 25 features). Text arm = the same folds, features and LightGBM settings (cv.fold_matrices + cv.fit_lgb_fold) plus description_text as word TF-IDF (1-2 grams, min_df=5, text lower-cased with text_flags.lower_tr) reduced by TruncatedSVD to 50 components; both fitted on each fold's training part only. Measured on both arms: R² on log price, MAPE, MAE; published as base, text and their differences.

statement.tr: Açıklama metni modele eklenince doğruluk anlamlı artmaz: log R² en fazla 0.005 artar ve MAPE en fazla 0,2 puan düşer.
statement.en: Adding the description text does not improve accuracy materially: log R² rises by less than 0.005 and MAPE falls by less than 0.2 points.

hypotheses.accept_if: delta_r2 = r2_log_text - r2_log_base < 0.005 AND mape_base - mape_text < 0.2 (percentage points)

out_of_scope: LLM extraction of facts from the text (not run: cost; the archived extraction is not used)
Other text representations (char n-grams, embeddings) or tuning the SVD size
Using the text in the served model
